about_the_game:
Cozy Campfire is a life adventure around several campfires, in varied and splendid settings. Through meetings and questions, you will write a beautiful life story full of empathy and sharing. In the safe place you have built, you can leave your stories and listen to those of others to create a collective tale full of compassion.

In this game, the goal is to welcome players from all over the world. By answering a variety of questions — sometimes funny, sometimes deep — you'll share your stories and the personal experiences that matter to you. There is no direct interaction with other players, allowing you to discover them at your own pace, while avoiding hurting yourself or others.

The game includes a creation mode where you can customize your campfire with a wide range of accessories (wood planks, toys, food, etc). You can create your avatar using 6 different models, each customizable with color selectors.

The campfires are beautiful, hand-painted and animated environments, highly diverse: from a night in the forest to a sunset on the beach, and many other unique and immersive ambiances. The music, a blend of soft and soothing symphonic melodies, adds a magical touch to every moment of play.

A progression system allows you to unlock new places, characters, and customization elements to enrich your safe place. To support you as best as possible during this journey of life and sharing.

To ensure a positive and caring experience, all answers are moderated and filtered. You can set content warnings to avoid certain topics according to your preferences. The game promotes empathy and respect, and will even encourage players to contribute to this great collective adventure to make the world a kinder, fairer, and more compassionate place.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+)
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be enough
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you have a very potato PC and the game runs slowly on it, feel free to contact me so I can update this.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: i5, Ryzen5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760
  • Storage: 1 MB available space

short_description: A game about sharing emotions and listening to the ones of other people. Embody a cute character, create your cosiest safe place and gather around the campfire to be a part of a collective story. We all need a good talk under the stars
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
